AimoCheckout.description: UCP's Checkout as typed by the AP2 SDK, plus our `aimo` key. No SDK field is renamed or removed.

id.description: Unique identifier of the checkout session.
id.title: Id

merchant.description: The merchant associated with the checkout.

line_items.description: Array of line items in the checkout.
line_items.title: Line Items

totals.description: Pricing breakdown. Must contain exactly one subtotal and one total entry.
totals.title: Totals

messages.description: List of messages with error and info about the checkout session state.
messages.title: Messages

AimoCheckout.title: AimoCheckout

AimoExtension.description: Everything of ours, under the one extra top-level key `aimo` that UCP's Checkout allows.
AimoExtension.title: AimoExtension

AllergenInfo.description: GS1 allergen codes. data='missing' never means 'free from'.
AllergenInfo.title: AllergenInfo

AuditEvent.description: One line of a hash-chained audit log. Each side keeps its own chain.
AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent

Buyer.description: Representation of the buyer. Matches UCP types/buyer.json (2026-04-08).
Buyer.title: Buyer

Claim.description: One fact Valio states, with where it comes from and how sure it is. `value` is null when unknown.
Claim.title: Claim

DemoAttack.description: One bad mandate sent straight to the gateway. `accepted` must never happen: it would mean Valio let it through.
DemoAttack.title: DemoAttack

DemoAudit.description: The lines both sides wrote about the quote on screen: the harness's log and the gateway's log.
DemoAudit.title: DemoAudit

DemoKitchen.description: The restaurant whose portal the page shows.
DemoKitchen.title: DemoKitchen

DemoRequest.description: What the buying agent was asked: the sentence the harness receives, and the needs sent to the gateway.
DemoRequest.title: DemoRequest

DemoRequestLine.description: One ingredient the kitchen needs, in the kitchen's unit. The quote says how many sales units that makes.
DemoRequestLine.title: DemoRequestLine

DemoScenarioRun.description: The scenario on screen. After a reset nothing has run: `id` and `title` are null and `status` is idle.
DemoScenarioRun.title: DemoScenarioRun

DemoStep.description: One step of the AP2 trail: who signed it, and a hash or an identifier that proves it.
DemoStep.title: DemoStep

Item.description: Product details for a line item. Matches UCP types/item.json (2026-04-08).

id.description: The product identifier, often the SKU, required to resolve the product details associated with this line item.
id.title: Id

price.description: Unit price in the currency's minor unit as defined by ISO 4217.
price.title: Price

Item.title: Item

JudgeAnswer.description: What we asked the judge and what came back. The model gives no explanation, so we keep the question.
JudgeAnswer.title: JudgeAnswer

LineClaims.description: Our facts for one line item, under aimo.lines[<line item id>].
LineClaims.title: LineClaims

LineItem.description: UCP line item (dev.ucp.shopping 2026-04-08). Uses nested item object for product details.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item being purchased.
quantity.title: Quantity

parent_id.description: Parent line item identifier for nested structures.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

LineItem.title: LineItem

Link.description: A typed URL reference for legal compliance or informational links.
Link.title: Link

Message.description: Container for error, warning, or info messages. Matches UCP types/message.json (2026-04-08).
Message.title: Message

code.description: Error code identifying the type of error.
code.title: Code

path.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath to the component the message refers to.
path.title: Path

path.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath to the component the message refers to.
path.title: Path

image_url.description: URL to a required visual element.
image_url.title: Image Url

Need.description: What the buyer asked for, in their own unit (litres, kilos or sales units).
Need.title: Need

Receipt.description: Decoded payload of the receipt JWT the gateway signs.
Receipt.title: Receipt

Severity.description: Reflects the resource state and recommended action.
Severity.title: Severity

Status.description: Checkout state indicating the current phase.
Status.title: Status

SubstituteFor.description: The product a substitute line replaces, signed with the quote so the harness can compare.
SubstituteFor.title: SubstituteFor

Total.description: A cost breakdown entry with a category, amount, and optional display text.

type.description: Cost category: subtotal, discount, items_discount, fulfillment, tax, fee, total.
type.title: Type

amount.description: Signed amount in minor currency units.
amount.title: Amount

Total.title: Total

description: Everything the page shows, in one object. The page never rebuilds a fact: it renders what is here.
title: DemoState
